title.narrative: Empowered Girls, Empowered Future

description.narrative: The specific objectives are to enhance capacity building of civil society organisations that work with disadvantaged girls; to support them to integrate gender-mainstreaming and inclusion across their policies, strategies and actions; to raise awareness of civil society, public and private stakeholders and enhance their cross-sectorial dialogue to advocate more effectively for gender-equality and social inclusion; to promote equal opportunities for disadvantaged girls and empower them through strengthening their active citizenship and leadership skills as well as providing quality learning opportunities for their stronger participation in societal, economic and democratic life.
